MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

4. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

5. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

7. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

8. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

13. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
